title: BINI, SB19, other PH artists earn nominations at Brazil’s BreakTudo Awards
summary: Filipino artists continue to take the global spotlight, this time with BINI, SB19, Arthur Nery and more OPM artists earning nominations at the 2026 BreakTudo Awards in Brazil. BINI bagged three…

blocks.text: Filipino artists continue to take the global spotlight, this time with BINI, SB19, Arthur Nery and more OPM artists earning nominations at the 2026 BreakTudo Awards in Brazil. BINI bagged three nominations including the international women’s group, international music video of the year, for “Sweet Tooth,” and international fandom of the year for its fans dubbed as Blooms. The P-pop girl group is up against international artists such as Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande, Lady Gaga, Blackpink, Twice, and Katseye, among others.
